snippet.title: ShapeHero Factory | Full Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
FULL RELEASE of ShapeHero Factory will be on...

🎮SEPT 17: Steam
🎮SEPT 18: PS5 & Nintendo Switch
*All dates are in Japanese Standard Time.

▼Official Website
https://www.asobism.co.jp/shapeherofactory/en/

▼Play the Early Access version today on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389040/ShapeHero_Factory/?utm_source=off&utm_campaign=fr&utm_medium=yt&utm_content=post&utm_term=en_2025_4

▼ShapeHero Factory
Factory Building × Roguelite × Tower Defense, all-in-one!
In this game, you’re the engineer of an ever-evolving paint-fuelled factory that spits out magical, shape-based warriors!
Send them into battle - to death or glory - then build an even better factory on your next run!

▼Official Discord Server
https://discord.gg/QSvU8ggv55

▼Official X
https://x.com/ShapeHero_GLB

#shapeherofactory #shapehero #indiegame #ps5 #NintendoSwitch #Steam
